answer: A meadow kiln keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must smelt its own marble ingot in a separate ember kiln, one ingot, one fire, one smith at a time. The first fake feeds its kiln 2 ember coals, the second 4, the third 8, the fourth 16, doubling every time, so the tenth fake alone burns 1,024 coals and twenty fakes together burn 2,097,150, while the twentieth fake alone needs 1,048,576. Bulk farming fails because one smith tends one kiln and no bellows stokes two fires at once, like one baker tending one oven, one loaf. Each coal is burned fresh, never bought.
